data.one_liner: Utilities for building command‑line interfaces, including argument parsing, analytics, and progress reporting.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of helper libraries for CLI applications such as a configurable command runner, analytics base class, and progress display. It also includes experimental command‑line completion support. The package is framework‑agnostic and can be used in any Dart project.
use_when: You need a ready‑made command runner with built‑in analytics and progress UI for a Dart CLI tool
You want easy integration of command‑line completion and configurable logging
avoid_when: You are building a GUI or web app
You require a full‑featured CLI framework with sub‑command scaffolding beyond what this package offers
strengths: Simple, opinionated API for common CLI needs
Built‑in analytics flushing and progress streams
weaknesses: Limited to command‑line use; no UI components
Breaking changes in recent versions may require migration
